scores.notes: Holmes at the window (left) has the gaunt, long-jawed face with receding slicked-back black hair that reads as Peter Cushing's screen Holmes, the same face scorers agreed on in other Holmes items; followed scorer B. Lettering ('MISSING' slip) was already agreed.
Holmes holding the bill fragment at the window (centre right) has the same gaunt Peter Cushing-like face and slicked hair; followed scorer B. 'The Standard' masthead lettering was already agreed.

Peter's staff (centre) stands upright on the water beside his open, ungripping hand, so it floats unsupported; followed scorer A. The agreed scene mismatch (Peter striding away from Jesus) also stands.

The framed print at the top-right corner fades to bare white paper at the image edge; recorded as accepted, following scorer B. Overall stays flawed for the agreed clock numerals and Cumberbatch likeness.

A gallery of human spectators fills the left side, including a prominent bearded old man in a red waistcoat in the foreground and fair-haired girls in blue near Alice, none of whom the cast or scene asks for; followed scorer A.
Holmes throwing the bundle (left) has the receding slicked-back hair, gaunt cheeks and long nose of the recurring Peter Cushing-like Holmes; followed scorer B. Newsprint lettering was already agreed.
The top-right corner behind the tree foliage is flat bare cream paper with no wash; followed scorer B, recorded as accepted. Overall flawed for the agreed watch-dial numerals.

The top edge, most clearly at the top-left and top-right corners, is a blank cream band above the hedge washes; followed scorer B, recorded as accepted. Overall flawed for the agreed card indices and Disney Queen costume.
The loose papers on the floor (bottom centre) carry ruled lines of pseudo-text; followed scorer A. Overall was already flawed for the second Alice and non-card guards.

The father running arms-wide toward the viewer with the son behind him is a single coherent moment staged wrongly, which the agreed scene mismatch already covers; no collage or impossible object; followed scorer A.
Zoomed, a short row of faint glyph-like strokes sits on the glowing wall just above and right of the spectral hand (top centre), distinct from the crack lines; followed scorer B.
Alice has three striped legs with three black shoes below her skirt (bottom centre), the leftmost reaching toward the Mock Turtle's foot; followed scorer B.

The right edge shows a ragged margin of white paper where the ground wash stops, from about a third to three-quarters of the way down; followed scorer B, recorded as accepted, so the item stays acceptable.

Both seraphim have six wings with faces covered and a lower pair beside the feet; bare toes show and one also raises its hands, but they are solemn, not comic, and God appears only as radiance; followed scorer A. The coal and tongs are an early detail, not a rule breach.

Cards at left and right carry small corner index glyphs; the Cheshire Cat floats with a full furry body and clawed forepaws, though the scene asked for a bodiless head; the Queen (right) wears the Disney red-bodice, yellow heart-panel skirt and tall white collar. Followed A on lettering and rule (for the Queen's costume), B on scene.

The bottom-left floor is painted grey with painted papers, not bare paper; the unselected Queen of Hearts sits prominently beside the King on the bench; Alice is about the King's scale and her grown size does not read. Followed scorer B on all three.
Zoomed, an isolated cursive-like squiggle that reads as handwritten letters sits on the floor below the sandals (bottom left of centre), unlike the surrounding ground hatching; followed scorer B.
A small notch of white paper bites into the right edge of the dark sky about a fifth of the way down; followed scorer A, recorded as accepted.
The left edge and the bottom-left corner fade from the stone washes into bare cream paper, and the top sky is near-white; followed scorer A, recorded as accepted.

The right-edge mist is painted lavender cloud with linework and the top is inked radiance, so no bare paper; but all four creatures wear draped red stoles and the calf is a docile, cute young calf, which makes them tame rather than strange and fearsome as the rule requires. Followed scorer B on both.
The top-left corner has a pale bare-paper patch at the very edge; followed scorer A, recorded as accepted. Overall flawed for the agreed pseudo-text and likeness.
The top-right sky is flat white paper, and a white band runs down the upper left edge; followed scorer A, recorded as accepted.
The road at the bottom-left corner fades into a pale bare-paper band at the left edge; followed scorer A, recorded as accepted. Overall flawed for the agreed Cushing likeness.
Peter stands with both feet on the boat's gunwale and thwart (centre), arms out, with no foot on the waves, so the asked step onto the water is not shown; followed scorer B.

A small inked 'oTm'-like signature sits in the bottom-right corner; bare paper shows at the bottom-left and bottom-right edges (accepted); the group walks toward the viewer, away from the burning house, rather than hastening toward it. Followed scorer A on all three.
A broad stone staircase on the right runs from Darius's rim down to the den floor, contradicting a pit Daniel must be hauled out of by the attendants' rope; followed scorer B.

An inked signature-like scrawl sits in the bottom-right corner; the top-left sky meets the edge in bare paper with a ragged wash edge (accepted); Aaron and Hur hold Moses' arms out level with his hands hanging limp, not raised. Followed A on lettering and edge, B on scene.
The boulder Darius seals sits at the edge of the round den opening, which stays visibly open and dark to its right, so the stone does not close the mouth it is sealing; followed scorer B.
The pale right side is the painted cream wall, mantel and floor washed to the edge, with no bare paper; followed scorer B. Overall flawed for the agreed pseudo-writing and likeness.

The left edge at both top and bottom corners shows white paper beyond the ragged dark wash, and a white strip runs across the top-right corner; followed scorer A, recorded as accepted. Overall flawed for the agreed lettering and likeness.
